briefdescription.para: A cuOptOptimizationProblem object contains a representation of an LP or MIP. It is created by cuOptCreateProblem or cuOptCreateRangedProblem. It is passed to cuOptSolve. It should be destroyed using cuOptDestroyProblem.

A cuOptSolverSettings object contains parameter settings and other information for an LP or MIP solve. It is created by cuOptCreateSolverSettings. It is passed to cuOptSolve. It should be destroyed using cuOptDestroySolverSettings.
A cuOptSolution object contains the solution to an LP or MIP. It is created by cuOptSolve. It should be destroyed using cuOptDestroySolution.
The type of the floating point number used by the solver. Use cuOptGetFloatSize to get the number of bytes in the floating point type.
The type of the integer number used by the solver. Use cuOptGetIntSize to get the size of the integer type.
Get the size of the float type.

simplesect.para: The size in bytes of the float type.

briefdescription.para: Get the size of the integer type used by the library.

simplesect.para: The size of the integer type in bytes.

simplesect.para: A status code indicating success or failure.

briefdescription.para: Create an optimization problem of the form.

para.verbatim: * minimize/maximize cᵀx + offset * subject to A x {=, ≤, ≥} b * l ≤ x ≤ u * x_i integer for some i *

parameterdescription.para: The number of constraints
The number of variables
The objective sense (CUOPT_MINIMIZE for minimization or CUOPT_MAXIMIZE for maximization)
An offset to add to the linear objective
A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_variables containing the coefficients of the linear objective

A pointer to an array of type cuopt_int_t of size num_constraints + 1. constraint_matrix_row_offsets[i] is the index of the first non-zero element of the i-th constraint in constraint_matrix_column_indices and constraint_matrix_coefficent_values. This is part of the compressed sparse row representation of the constraint matrix

A pointer to an array of type cuopt_int_t of size constraint_matrix_row_offsets[num_constraints] containing the column indices of the non-zero elements of the constraint matrix. This is part of the compressed sparse row representation of the constraint matrix

A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size constraint_matrix_row_offsets[num_constraints] containing the values of the non-zero elements of the constraint matrix. This is part of the compressed sparse row representation of the constraint matrix
A pointer to an array of type char of size num_constraints containing the sense of the constraints (CUOPT_LESS_THAN, CUOPT_GREATER_THAN, or CUOPT_EQUAL)
A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_constraints containing the right-hand side of the constraints
A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_variables containing the lower bounds of the variables
A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_variables containing the upper bounds of the variables
A pointer to an array of type char of size num_variables containing the types of the variables (CUOPT_CONTINUOUS or CUOPT_INTEGER)
Pointer to store the created optimization problem

simplesect.para: CUOPT_SUCCESS if successful, CUOPT_ERROR otherwise

briefdescription.para: Create an optimization problem of the form *.

para.verbatim: * minimize/maximize c^T x + offset * subject to bl <= A*x <= bu * l <= x <= u * x_i integer for some i *

parameterdescription.para: - The number of constraints.
- The number of variables.
- The objective sense (CUOPT_MINIMIZE for minimization or CUOPT_MAXIMIZE for maximization)
- An offset to add to the linear objective.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_variables containing the coefficients of the linear objective.

- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_int_t of size num_constraints + 1. constraint_matrix_row_offsets[i] is the index of the first non-zero element of the i-th constraint in constraint_matrix_column_indices and constraint_matrix_coefficients.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_int_t of size constraint_matrix_row_offsets[num_constraints] containing the column indices of the non-zero elements of the constraint matrix.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size constraint_matrix_row_offsets[num_constraints] containing the values of the non-zero elements of the constraint matrix.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_constraints containing the lower bounds of the constraints.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_constraints containing the upper bounds of the constraints.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_variables containing the lower bounds of the variables.
- A pointer to an array of type cuopt_float_t of size num_variables containing the upper bounds of the variables.
- A pointer to an array of type char of size num_variables containing the types of the variables (CUOPT_CONTINUOUS or CUOPT_INTEGER).
- A pointer to a cuOptOptimizationProblem. On output the problem will be created and initialized with the provided data.

simplesect.para: A status code indicating success or failure.
